title: Year of birth scrambled when typed quickly (1991 saved as 1919)
observed: Typing '1991' in YYYY at normal automated speed produced '1919'; typing slowly worked. Day field also silently dropped extra digits instead of advancing.
expected: Input mask preserves keystroke order at any speed; DOB auto-advances or accepts DDMMYYYY.

title: Next question's option renders under the cursor and looks pre-selected (mis-click risk on risk answers)
observed: After choosing 5 years insured, the '5 or more' claims option rendered under the cursor already highlighted; same pattern put 'Business Only' under the cursor after 'No' finance, and on gender, licence and currently-insured steps.
expected: New question renders with no hover state, or a short input lock after navigation, so a double-click cannot answer two questions.

title: Single checkbox bundles privacy/FSG acceptance with marketing email/SMS and partner call consent
observed: One required tick-box accepts the Privacy Collection Notice and FSG AND agrees to marketing email/SMS AND invites partner calls when a number is given.
expected: Separate, optional consent for marketing and calls.

title: Accessibility: Invalid ARIA markup, so the tab state may be announced wrongly (car-insurance, WCAG 4.1.2)
observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'aria-allowed-attr' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance. e.g. #tab-0-tab:
expected: Ensure an element's role supports its ARIA attributes
suggested_fix: aria-selected=" true " is not allowed (stray spaces) See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-allowed-attr

title: Enter key doesn't submit text steps; Next only enables on blur
observed: Pressing Enter after typing kilometres did nothing; DOB Next stayed disabled until focus left the year field.
expected: Enter submits a valid step; Next enables as soon as input is valid.

title: DOB inputs have no labels; address page title says 'Cover Type'
observed: DD/MM/YYYY inputs have no label or aria-label (placeholders only); document title on car_address was 'Cover Type - Car Quote'.
expected: Labelled inputs; page titles match the step.

title: Accessibility: An ARIA value is malformed (e.g. ' true ' with spaces) (car-insurance, WCAG 4.1.2)
observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'aria-valid-attr-value' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance. e.g. #tab-0-tab:
expected: Ensure all ARIA attributes have valid values
suggested_fix: Invalid ARIA attribute value: aria-selected=" true " See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-valid-attr-value

title: Accessibility: Text too faint to read comfortably (15 steps, WCAG 1.4.3)
observed: 30 element(s) fail axe rule 'color-contrast' (, axe impact serious) on 15 step(s): /car-insurance, /car-insurance/journey/start, /car-insurance/journey/standard_options, /car-insurance/journey/car_address, /car-insurance/journey/car_make, /car-insurance/journey/car_year, /car-insurance/journey/car_model, /car-insurance/journey/non_standard_accessories …. e.g. .text-greyscale-300 > p:
expected: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA

title: Accessibility: A scrolling box can't be reached or scrolled with the keyboard (car-insurance, WCAG 2.1.1)
observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'scrollable-region-focusable' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance. e.g. #david-koch-car-insurance-transcript:
expected: Ensure elements that have scrollable content are accessible by keyboard
suggested_fix: Element should be focusable or contain focusable content See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/scrollable-region-focusable

title: Accessibility: Tap targets are too small to hit reliably (car_series, WCAG 2.5.8)
observed: 9 element(s) fail axe rule 'target-size' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_series. e.g. #internal-link-KIA\ 18AQ:
expected: Ensure touch targets have sufficient size and space
suggested_fix: Target partially obscured (345px by 10px); should be at least 24px by 24px See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/target-size

title: Every journey step shows 4-5s blank grey screen; journey/initial re-posted on every step
observed: Each step transition shows a blank page for ~4-5s; network shows POST api/car-journey/journey/initial plus several server_time calls per step. 1100+ console messages over the session.
expected: Sub-second step transitions; journey initialised once.

title: Accessibility: A control is nested inside another, so focus and announcements break (start, WCAG 4.1.2)
observed: 1 element(s) fail axe rule 'nested-interactive' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/start. e.g. .registration_number__none__tEhej:
expected: Ensure interactive controls are not nested

title: Two identical variants differ only by 'Release: January' vs 'May' with no guidance
observed: Both YP S variants show identical engine/transmission/power/drive/kerb mass; only release month differs.
expected: Explain how to tell them apart or merge identical variants.

title: Accessibility: A form field has no name, so it's announced as just 'edit text' (car_address, WCAG 1.3.1 / 4.1.2)
observed: 1 element(s) fail axe rule 'label' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_address. e.g. #coverDetail\.overnightParking\.address\.buildingName:
expected: Ensure every form element has a label
suggested_fix: Building Name input has no programmatic label See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/label

title: Accessibility: A link looks like plain text (colour is the only difference) (car_address, WCAG 1.4.1)
observed: 1 element(s) fail axe rule 'link-in-text-block' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_address. e.g. #overnightParkingAddressToggle:
expected: Ensure links are distinguished from surrounding text without relying on color
suggested_fix: Link contrast 1.3:1 with surrounding text and no underline See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/link-in-text-block

title: Accessibility: A dropdown has no name; users don't know what they're choosing (car_address, WCAG 4.1.2)
observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'select-name' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_address. e.g. #coverDetail\.overnightParking\.address\.unitType:
expected: Ensure select element has an accessible name
suggested_fix: Unit type and Suburb selects have no accessible name See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/select-name

title: Cover help text mislabels TPFT and states <$20k rule that the journey doesn't apply
observed: Help calls it 'Third party property, fire and theft' vs button 'Third Party Fire and Theft'; says TPFT only for cars under $20,000 but offers it for a 2019 Carnival. Comprehensive wording reads as if own-car damage only covered when at fault. Popover covers the heading and third option.
expected: Consistent names, accurate eligibility, help that doesn't obscure options.

title: Accessibility: Tabs aren't inside a tab list, so they aren't announced as tabs (standard_options, WCAG 1.3.1)
observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'aria-required-parent' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/standard_options. e.g. #factory:
expected: Ensure elements with an ARIA role that require parent roles are contained by them
suggested_fix: Required ARIA parent role not present: tablist See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-required-parent

title: 'None' years offered after answering Yes to comprehensive cover in last 12 months
observed: Follow-up allows 'None' full years despite prior Yes.
expected: Options consistent with previous answer.

title: Copy: "KM's" and "drivers licence"
observed: 'KM's travelled per year', '290 KM's per week', 'their drivers licence'.
expected: 'km', 'driver's licence'.

title: 'Car Park' and 'Parking Lot' offered as separate parking options
observed: Both options shown with no explanation of difference.
expected: One option or a clear distinction.

title: Production journey record + marketing call created before any contact details
observed: Network shows journey id created and POST .../journey/{id}/marketings during the anonymous journey.
expected: Synthetic sessions tagged and excluded downstream before scheduled prod runs.

title: Empty email field shown green/valid before input
observed: Email field has a green 'valid' border while empty.
expected: Neutral until validated.
